apbCatalogR: look up APB result fields by meaning

Source: R/apbCatalogR-package.R
apbCatalogR-package.Rd

The R implementation of apb-catalog. It works on the bundle apb-catalog releases: apb2's effective parse rules, the reviewed catalogue sets and the answers apb-catalog gives on synthetic results. Catalog answers which column one software version reports for a meaning, without data; DataCatalog answers on a result read with read_parsed_levels().

Details

The package ships a bundle; update_catalog() downloads a newer one and catalog_version() reports the one in use.

Conditions

Lookups signal conditions of the classes apb-catalog raises in Python:

  • UnresolvedField: the catalogue cannot answer with one field; the request is ambiguous or unknown. Its resolution holds the candidates and reasons.

  • StaleField: the result's stored rule declares the field differently from the bundle's rule.

  • MissingRequiredField: a field the set requires is missing, under enforce. Signalled as an error, or as a warning for a SHOULD field when enforce = "MUST".

Catch them with tryCatch(), for example tryCatch(..., UnresolvedField = function(condition) NULL).
